subject: Release memo — f00tils 0.16.10
ref: PATH supersede failure on TTY/non-login; /usr/bin bare names + conflicts
opening: Bottom line: 0.16.10 installs bare names as real /usr/bin symlinks and conflicts with GNU coreutils/findutils/grep/diffutils. Replace works in every session (TTY included) with no profile.d/zshenv dependency. PATH helpers remain only for curl ~/.local installs.

sections.heading: 1. Why
sections.body: PATH-based replace could not cover every session (non-login bash, clean env, TTY edge cases). Coreutils works because it owns /usr/bin.

sections.heading: 2. Change
items: pacman/deb/rpm: provides+conflicts+replaces coreutils findutils grep diffutils
Bare names: /usr/bin/find → f00 (and full tool list)
After install: which find → /usr/bin/find and that file is f00

sections.heading: 3. Upgrade note
sections.body: paru will remove GNU coreutils/findutils/grep/diffutils when installing f00. That is intentional. Side-by-side: F00_SUPERSEDE=0 curl install.

steps.text: paru -S f00 (accept removal of GNU packages)
On TTY: which find; find --version → f00
